We need propose a 5-step retrosynthesis for target SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We need to produce JSON route with 5 reactions. Use templates from catalog. We have found a template for deprotecting TBS: template 29646 (retro: [C:2]-[OH]>>C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si](-C)(-C)-[O]-[C:2]) which is reverse of protection: i.e., forward is protection, retro is deprotection. Our target has free OH groups? The target has multiple OH: one on ring (secondary alcohol), one on side chain (primary alcohol from CH2OH), and a carboxylic acid at end. Also there is a TBS group? Actually target SMILES includes O[C@H]1... no silyl. So maybe we need to protect during synthesis, but final product is deprotected. So retrosynthesis step could be deprotection to give TBS-protected precursor.

Thus step1 (retro) = deprotect TBS: apply template 29646 to target to get precursor with TBS group on that OH. That will add a TBS group to the secondary alcohol? The template adds C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si](-C)(-C)-O- to the carbon bearing OH. So we get a TBS ether.

Now we need other steps: maybe Still-Gennari HWE to form the (Z)-alkene linking side chain? The target has conjugated polyene chain with terminal carboxylic acid. Could be formed via Still-Gennari from aldehyde and phosphonate. So retro step: break C=C double bond formed in Still-Gennari, generating aldehyde and phosphonate ester.

We need template for Still-Gennari (HWE Z). Search for functional groups broken: "C-C double bonds" formed, "carboxylic esters" formed. But we need reverse: break double bond, form carbonyl and phosphonate? Might be template with functional_groups_broken: ["C-C double bonds"] and formed: ["aldehydes","carboxylic esters"]? Not sure.

Alternatively use Horner-Wadsworth-Emmons (HWE) to form double bond and ester. So retro: break double bond, generate aldehyde and phosphonate ester.

Search for template with broken C-C double bonds, formed aldehydes and carboxylic esters. Let's try.
